title.narrative: Urban Infrastructure Project

description.narrative: The project supports the Government of Bhutan's efforts toward sustainable urban development in its two largest municipalities (Phuentsholing and Thimphu) and two emerging urban centers (Samdrup Jongkhar Municipality [SJM] and Nganglam Town). It has four outputs: (i) water supply and sanitation (WSS) infrastructure rehabilitation and expansion; (ii) mobility improvement; (iii) urban management strengthening; and (iv) project management and capacity development.

title.narrative: Loan 2816: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 30 Jan 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: All project activities are completed; financial closing in progress.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44240/44240-013-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Oct 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44240/44240-013-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jan 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44240/44240-013-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Aug 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44240/44240-013-smr-en_8.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Construction of 2.5MLD WTP in Samdrupjongkhar was completed in January 2020 and operating under manual commission. The expert of the contractor is working for full automated commissioning which has been delayed by COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns. Construction of 12MLD WWTP in Thimphu was completed in December 2021 and operating under fully automated mode. The project had procured 1 suction machine and 1 water tanker in 2016 for Phuentsholing Thromde. SamdrupJongkhar Thromde had also procured 2 water tankers and 1 suction machine in 2016. Staff from Thimphu Thromde are currently attached with the contractor on capacity building of WWTP under the O&M period implemented by the contractor. Auto commissioning of Samdrup Jongkhar WTP is delayed. Samdrup Jongkhar Thromdee will attach staff, for capacity building and knowledge transfer on O&M, with the contractor once the facility is auto commissioned. About 234 Municipal/District/DES Engineers, including Office Assistants have been trained within June 2017, and 5 MOWHS staff attended the study visit on bridge open foundation. The project has been closed wef 31 December 2021 and liquidation period for financial closing has been extended from 30 April to 31 October 2022.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/44240-013/main#project-tenders
